### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

# **Flow***flex*® **PLUS**

## RSV + Flu A/B + COVID

## Home Test

for ages 6 months and up
[Learn More][25]
[[ACON - Making Point-of-care testing affordable around the world]][26]

## Making Point-of-care testing affordable around the world

Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

These products are used in hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices, blood banks,
pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

#### Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection
reagent strips are highly reliable and easy to use.

[View Product][30]
[ACON Laboratories, Inc]

#### Lateral Flow Rapid Tests

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]
[Mission POCT]

#### Our Newest Brand

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

#### Molecular Diagnostics

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]
[[ACON San Diego]][37]

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended
team, our focused acquisition strategy is essential as we accelerate the power of science and
technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

Our businesses

[A microscopic image of a cell]

pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than

the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

products and platforms to create the technologies and applications that will become the foundation

## Screen for 50+ cancers with a single blood test

The Galleri^{®} multi-cancer early detection test identifies DNA in the bloodstream shed by cancer
cells^{1 }and does not predict future genetic risk for cancer. 

HSA/FSA eligible*

[ Request the test ][45]

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers, and false positive or false negative
results can occur.

*Check with your plan to confirm eligibility

[2024 compilation]
Play Video Cookie notice ⓘ

## Now there’s a proactive tool to screen for cancer

The Galleri test can be taken annually as a simple blood test and screens for a “fingerprint” of
many of the deadliest cancers before they become symptomatic, including those with no recommended
screening tests today.^{1,2,3}

[ About the Galleri test ][46]
[ What does Galleri screen for? ][47]

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers, and false positive or false negative
results can occur. The Galleri test should be used in addition to healthcare provider recommended
screening tests.

### A multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test

Capable of screening for cancers before they become symptomatic, including those that don’t have
recommended screening tests today.

# World wide horse transportation

Welcome to Horse Service International (HSI). We are an international horse transport company with
an excellent reputation in the world of professional horses. We will cater for all of your
international horse transport by air and within Europe we provide road transportation.

# We make the horses wellbeing our priority

## What do we offer?

HSI offers specialised transports for horses to and from any national, international and
intercontinental destination. Our experienced team at the office, in the stables and at the airport
makes sure that everything is well organised.


#### About Us

Horse Service International

# We offer the best way to transport your horse
* 1 The horses fly under the guidance of professional and experienced groom(s).
* 2 We arrange travel documents for you.
* 3 Our experienced team at the office, in the stables and at the airport ensures that everything is
  properly arranged.
* 4 We can quickly guide you through the correct health certificates, quarantine requirements and

[Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits, STD Test Kits, Blood Glucose Monitoring Systems Manufacturer ]

# **Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits and Blood Glucose Monitoring Systems Manufacturer & Distributor**

JAL Medical Singapore Group of Companies (JAL Medical & JAL Innovation) rapid diagnostic test kits
manufacturer, and one of the diagnostic companies in Singapore, is a subsidiary of OK Biotech Co.
Ltd., a publicly traded company. Company’s headquarter’s is in Hsinchu, Taiwan. We have , ISO 13485,
and GMP certifications. Our overall purpose is to provide a fully centralized biomedicine production
plant that offers a full variety of patented diabetes testing devices and in-vitro screening testing
kits to our partners around the world.

The JAL Medical Business unit has been in the healthcare industry for 20 years and is now recognised
as being among the world’s finest manufacturers and worldwide distributors of quick diagnostics test
kits. The firm a rapid testing companies is also a world’s largest producer of blood glucose
monitoring equipment.

We as a vitro diagnostics company are dedicated to serving our stakeholders by creating and
distributing high-quality, dependable, and economical commodities / services throughout all
continents. Our mission is to deliver efficient, dependable, and cost-effective products in
international market.
**Our Group’s Key Business Divisions are:**
* Manufacturing of a wide range of Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits, drug testing kits, in-vitro
  diagnostic kits, Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Test, Chlamydia Rapid Screen Test, biotech test kit,
  including a comprehensive line of STD test kits , Menopause Test Kits, etc. for professional and
  personal usage.
* Production of a wide range of blood glucose monitoring systems for professional and personal
  usage.
* Experienced Consulting for the Development and Manufacturing of Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits
* Health Supplements – The Company has teamed up with Nutrisyz Singapore to create and market an
  intriguing line of innovative medicine and herbal-based health products throughout the world. The
  Singapore Health Science Authority has authorised and listed this high-efficacy Chinese
  Proprietary Medical (CPM) (HSA).

[Biomedical Solutions, Healthcare ]

## Latest News of JAL Medical Group of Companies

We are glad to report that the JAL Medical Group of Companies (JAL Medical Singapore & JAL
Innovation Singapore), in collaboration with our South African partner Armada Diagnostics Pty Ltd,
has consistently won the South African National Department of Health from 2014 to 2023.

We are delivering our co-branded WHO pre-qualified HIV 1&2 testing kits as part of a united
collective collaboration. We are quite pleased to report that we have won the third contract in a
row.

These contracts are believed to be the biggest global delivery of diagnostic test kits.  Throughout
those years, about 65 million diagnostic test kits were provided and effectively deployed. We intend
to provide further 42 million diagnostic test kits under the revised tender allotment from 2021 to
2023.

Furthermore, JAL Medical Singapore has a substantial market share for our iCare Advanced blood
glucose screening devices in Laos, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, and Indonesia, to mention a few countries.

Our rapid diagnostics STD test kits for domestic use are provided to essential projects in Myanmar,
Laos, New Zealand, Equatorial New Guinea, Thailand, and other Pacific and Caribbean Islands.

The international prosperity has been aided by our great teamwork, strong brand image, constant
quality of products, and excellent services.

We’d like to sincerely thank all of our international clients for their contributions to our success
over the last 20 years.

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,

requirements for research.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[Hospital samples of donated blood][Hospital samples of donated blood]

### How do I book a blood test with Swift Blood Tests?

> Booking takes less than two minutes. Choose your blood test, select a clinic appointment or home
> visit, pick a convenient time, and pay securely online. If you’re unsure which test you need, call
> us and we’ll help you choose the right option before you book.

 

### What areas do you cover?

We provide clinic appointments at our Billericay location and partner clinics across the UK. Home
visits are available throughout Essex, Bromley and Surrey. If you’re unsure whether we cover your
area, contact us and we’ll confirm availability.

### Are your phlebotomists qualified?

Yes — all of our phlebotomists are fully trained, experienced, and qualified to carry out safe and
professional blood collection. We work under strict clinical standards and are CQC registered for
quality and safety.

### Can I book a blood test without a referral from my doctor?

Yes — you do not need a GP referral to book a private blood test with Swift Blood Tests. You can
choose from our wide range of tests and book directly online or by phone.

### How soon will I get my results?

Most results are available within 24–48 hours. Some specialist tests may take a little longer, but
you will always be informed of the expected turnaround time when booking.

### Do I need a referral from my GP to book a blood test?

> No. Most of our private blood tests can be booked without a GP referral. Simply choose the test
> you need, book online, and attend your appointment or arrange a home visit. If you’re unsure which
> test is right for you, our team is happy to help.

 

### How will I receive my results?

Results are delivered securely by email or via our online portal. If you’d like, we can also arrange
a follow-up consultation to explain your results and next steps.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I book a blood test with Swift Blood Tests?

> Booking takes less than two minutes. Choose your blood test, select a clinic appointment or home
> visit, pick a convenient time, and pay securely online. If you’re unsure which test you need, call
> us and we’ll help you choose the right option before you book.

 

### What areas do you cover?

We provide clinic appointments at our Billericay location and partner clinics across the UK. Home
visits are available throughout Essex, Bromley and Surrey. If you’re unsure whether we cover your
area, contact us and we’ll confirm availability.

### Are your phlebotomists qualified?

Yes — all of our phlebotomists are fully trained, experienced, and qualified to carry out safe and
professional blood collection. We work under strict clinical standards and are CQC registered for
quality and safety.

### Can I book a blood test without a referral from my doctor?

Yes — you do not need a GP referral to book a private blood test with Swift Blood Tests. You can
choose from our wide range of tests and book directly online or by phone.

### How soon will I get my results?

Most results are available within 24–48 hours. Some specialist tests may take a little longer, but
you will always be informed of the expected turnaround time when booking.

### Do I need a referral from my GP to book a blood test?

> No. Most of our private blood tests can be booked without a GP referral. Simply choose the test
> you need, book online, and attend your appointment or arrange a home visit. If you’re unsure which
> test is right for you, our team is happy to help.

 

### How will I receive my results?

Results are delivered securely by email or via our online portal. If you’d like, we can also arrange
a follow-up consultation to explain your results and next steps.

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

## How it Works

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

[View Testing Guides][52]

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.
